rules: Use Outfit for all headings to provide a premium, modern feel. Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Use Manrope for body text to ensure crisp legibility and Scandinavian minimalism.
Headings should use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Avoid centering text excessively; rely on left-alignment for a modern structured flow.
Hero uses a blue/white base for the cartoon aesthetic (matching the Alamy reference).
Accent color is soft green (#10B981) for buttons, active states, and success markers.
Typography is deep charcoal (#1F2937) for a premium, grounded feel.

textures: Sparkle and bubble SVG elements floating in the hero section.
Use Framer Motion to create slow, drifting parallax for floating objects in the background.

layouts.hero: Full-height (min-h-[90vh]), flex-col center. Headline 'Rent hem. Mer tid för dig.', Privat/Företag prominent choices. 5-item Trust bar at bottom. Utilize /modernstad-hero.png for the hero illustration and overlay parallax elements.
layouts.wizard: Max-width container (max-w-6xl). 2-Column layout on desktop: Left column contains the 8-Step vertical or horizontal progress indicator and Active form card. Right column contains the Live Summary side-panel.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12 for containers. gap-6 to gap-10 for grids.

rules: Use smooth, soft transitions (e.g., ease: 'easeOut', duration: 0.5).
No bouncy/flashy animations. The feel must be high-end.
Implement parallax movement on scroll for hero background elements (bubbles, cleaners, sparkles).
Fade and slide-up (y: 20 -> 0) for wizard step transitions.

steps: 03 RUT (Är du berättigad till RUT-avdrag? Ja/Nej + info-länk)
04 Städning (Vilket erbjudande, Antal timmar, Bostadens storlek, Hur ofta, Starttid)
07 Övrigt (Meddelande, Vill du bli kontaktad viss dag/tid, Villkor, CAPTCHA)

instructions_to_main_agent: Write all React code in .js files, NOT .tsx. Use standard PropTypes or plain JS.
Implement the entire UI in Swedish as specified.
Use lucide-react for all standard icons.
For the hero section, use the provided public/modernstad-hero.png. Enhance it with floating sparkles/bubbles using framer-motion to create a parallax effect.
Build out the 8-step booking wizard with Framer Motion transitions.
Implement the live pricing summary which automatically updates based on travel zone and cleaning choices.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='step-1-next').
DO NOT use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Apply backdrop-blur-xl with a semi-transparent background (bg-white/80).
Never apply universal 'transition: all' in CSS. Target specific properties.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards (deep charcoal text on off-white).
